training_set_in_paper: Not trained in SynthScope. Only the official weights are evaluated (EricTan7/VeritasPP @ 22ba6c6b, Qwen3-VL-8B fine-tuned by the authors; inference only, greedy decoding, unparsed answers counted wrong). The paper's tables 2 and 3 are the reference; the benchmark subsets of the SynthScope matrix (L = ceil(500 / generators) per class and generator, identical images for 27 other detectors) are in repro/vlm_bench/.

benchmarks.name: WildRF (Facebook, Reddit, Twitter test sets), full data, 2,503 images
benchmarks.metric: accuracy over all images (unparsed answers dropped, as the authors' script; 0 here)

paper_number.note: Veritas++ paper Table III, VERITAS++ row (not the dagger row).

our_number.note: Greedy decoding, official weights, full data: 95.65 acc (-0.75). On a 988-image subset: greedy 95.65, the authors' sampled setting (T 0.7) 96.46 (+0.06). The paper states no temperature. Full run 13.8 GPU-h (judgement call: above the 12 h guideline).

benchmarks.name: RealChain (7 generators), 1,008-image subset
benchmarks.metric: accuracy over all images (unparsed dropped; 0 here)

paper_number.note: Veritas++ paper Table III, VERITAS++ row.

our_number.note: Subset only (72 reals + 72 fakes per generator, 7% of the data), greedy: 82.74 acc (+0.44), close but not a full-data run. Weak generators: Seedream4 fake acc 31.9, image-to-image 22.2. Ranks 1st of 28 detectors on the same images.

benchmarks.name: EvalGEN (5 generators), 500-fake subset
benchmarks.metric: accuracy on the fakes only (our inference of the paper's metric, from DDA's row 97.2)

paper_number.note: Veritas++ paper Table II, VERITAS++ row. The paper does not say how EvalGen is scored; fakes-only is our inference.

our_number.note: NOT reproduced on full data: 500-fake subset (of 55,298), greedy. 98.20 fakes only (-1.30), 99.10 balanced with MSCOCO reals (-0.40). NOVA is the only weak generator (91.0, 100 fakes).

benchmarks.name: 15 held benchmarks, subsampled (L = ceil(500 / generators)), vs 27 detectors on identical images
benchmarks.metric: balanced accuracy (mean over generators) and AUROC of the verdict-token logit gap

paper_number.note: No paper numbers: a cross-benchmark comparison, not in the paper.

our_number.note: Subsampled, official weights, greedy, unparsed counted wrong (10 of 17,935); mean of the 15 accuracies 84.70 (median detector 76.25, best public CuRe 89.27, MIRROR 95.30). 1st of 28 on RRDataset and RealChain, weak on GANs (ForenSynths 25th). JPEG95: UFD-8 -5.26 acc, DiTFake +0.10.
